briefing: Market was mildly positive today (NASDAQ +0.8%, S&P 500 +0.7%) but this falls short of the strong risk-on signal (+2%+) that historically justified deploying cash, and current cash of $189.29 is well below the $500 threshold needed for a meaningful new position anyway. Holding all 7 existing positions and skipping new buys today.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Dry powder is cash kept in reserve rather than invested, ready to be deployed when a genuinely strong opportunity appears. Today's gain was modest and cash reserves are too thin for a meaningful new position, so the disciplined choice is to hold cash and wait rather than force a trade.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「乾火藥」（Dry Powder）指預留未投資的現金，待出現真正強勁的機會時才動用。今日升幅溫和，現金儲備亦不足以建立有意義的新倉位，因此紀律性的做法是持有現金、耐心等待，而非勉強交易。

market_education.summary_en: U.S. equities drifted modestly higher, with the Nasdaq up 0.8% and the S&P 500 up 0.7%, a mildly risk-on session without a decisive breakout. No single catalyst dominated the day's price action, and the gains lacked the broad-based volume surge typically seen on genuine risk-on days. With portfolio cash below the deployment threshold, the prudent move was to hold existing positions rather than chase a modest up day.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日溫和上揚，納指升0.8%，標普500升0.7%，屬偏溫和的風險偏好情緒，並未出現明確突破。今日走勢沒有單一主導消息，升幅亦缺乏真正風險偏好日常見的放量支持。由於組合現金低於部署門檻，較審慎的做法是繼續持有現有倉位，而非追逐這種溫和升市。
